name: ast-core-infra
description: Alchemy IaC for ast-core (isolated deploy tooling; Effect 4 per Alchemy peers; service stays on Effect 3).

scripts.build: npm run build:web -- && npm run build:worker --
scripts.check: npm run build -- && npm run typecheck -- && npm run test -- && npm run verify:bundle --
scripts.deploy: npm run build -- && npm run verify:bundle -- && npx --no-install alchemy deploy --config alchemy.run.ts
scripts.plan: npm run build -- && npm run verify:bundle -- && npx --no-install alchemy deploy --dry-run --config alchemy.run.ts
